audit_type: read-only evidence assessment; no experiment/model executed
basis: Original full-scope directive sections 4-9, AGENTS.md, docs/architecture.md, Mission014 evidence

status_definitions.COMPLETE: Implemented and validated within the exact stated claim
status_definitions.UNVALIDATED: Implemented but empirical claim not established
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Requires external resource or human decision

scope_note: Conditional speech and adjacent Neuralink competencies are identified but not silently promoted to original release gates; negative scientific findings are not software failures.

requirements.requirement: Adaptive neural intelligence thesis and empirical success
requirements.existing: Specific decoding, calibration and SSL hypotheses were executed; negative and mixed outcomes retained.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: No replicated evidence that learned representations generalize broadly across sessions, subjects or tasks.
requirements.consequence: The thesis cannot be reported as a demonstrated platform property.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: No; researcher chooses scientific claim, effect threshold and interpretation.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Independent prespecified recordings and controls support a claim at researcher-chosen practical threshold, or the hypothesis is explicitly rejected without changing software status.

requirements.requirement: Prespecified hypotheses, estimands and falsification rules
requirements.existing: Experiments record hypotheses, splits, targets, comparisons and limits. Mission014 protocol preceded outcome inspection.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: No single prospective broad-transfer estimand or practical superiority threshold is fixed for future release-level claims.
requirements.consequence: Post hoc selection can overstate generality even with valid software.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: Conditional; Codex can draft, researcher must select and approve.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Before new analysis, publish dataset IDs, primary contrast, independent unit, budget, effect threshold, uncertainty rule and stop rule; freeze before outcomes.

requirements.requirement: SENSE/MAP/DECODE/REMEMBER/ADAPT/FOUNDATION/INTERACT boundaries
requirements.existing: Documented boundaries map to working Python modules, CLIs and reports.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Existing module boundaries and executed workflows remain available without new scaffolding.

requirements.requirement: Reusable cross-dataset scientific data contract
requirements.existing: Maze uses a Recording dataclass; LINK/FALCON expose separate adapter dictionaries and proven workflows.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: A new modality still needs bespoke trial/coverage/target translation; no common validated adapter contract across all three.
requirements.consequence: Extending to another dataset is manual and risks inconsistent units or masks.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: Conditional; Codex can implement when a new dataset is actually selected.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A new supported recording passes shared clock, coverage, trial identity and unit assertions using a documented adapter contract without changing existing results.

requirements.requirement: Versioned authentic acquisition, QC and provenance
requirements.existing: Maze Small/standard, four native LINK sessions and FALCON calibration assets are pinned and audited; 11 manifests verified in Mission014.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Pinned manifest, checksum, license, clocks and coverage policy remain reproducible for currently supported data.

requirements.requirement: Perich longitudinal neural coverage
requirements.existing: Two Perich recordings were natively audited; model exclusion policy is enforced.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: No authoritative neural observation intervals were established.
requirements.consequence: Silent bins cannot be certified as recorded silence; modeling would violate the human coverage requirement.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: No; Codex can inspect supplied evidence, not create missing acquisition provenance.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Authoritative per-unit or continuous-recording coverage, clock relation and file identity are documented, checked against native files, then model eligibility is reconsidered.

requirements.requirement: Original FALCON EMG target access and split-safe processing
requirements.existing: Eight authentic calibration sessions have neural coverage and published normalized EMG; converter provenance was traced.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: Raw unrectified EMG and scaling constants are absent from inspected public NWBs; rectification/clipping/resampling cannot be inverted. Exact B conversion details are incomplete.
requirements.consequence: Original target processing precedes CEREBRO splits; strict leakage-free raw-target cross-subject inference is not established.
dependencies: authoritative raw EMG, clocks, calibration provenance and use terms; or suitable alternative data
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: No; Codex cannot reconstruct erased source values.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Obtain verifiable raw targets/clock metadata and researcher-approved split-safe processing, or adopt independently suitable data; repeat fixed controls on untouched evaluation, preserving old exploratory results.

requirements.requirement: Cross-subject independent recordings and compatible targets
requirements.existing: FALCON has eight audited dates but only two animals; anonymous count features and 16 muscle names support exploratory comparison.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: No independent subject cohort with certified train-only original target processing was validated.
requirements.consequence: Subject, date, session and preprocessing effects remain confounded.
dependencies: researcher-selected suitable cohort and target definition
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: No; Codex can audit/run accessible suitable data only after selection and access.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: At least one independent subject-level evaluation with documented neural coverage, compatible target units, prespecified preprocessing and held-out subjects/dates; report failed as well as successful contrasts.

requirements.requirement: Speech recording extension, where legal and compatible
requirements.existing: No speech adapter, manifest, target or experiment.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: Appropriate public speech neural dataset, permissions and scientific target not selected.
requirements.consequence: Speech-related generality cannot be assessed; the original directive made this a conditional later extension, not an existing release claim.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: Conditional; Codex can implement only after access and design approval.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: If included in approved scope, pin a legally usable corpus and implement coverage/clock/target validation plus an honest held-out experiment; otherwise record explicit deferral.

requirements.requirement: PCA, FA, train-only selection and interpretation
requirements.existing: PCA/FA run on real Maze data with inner selection, reconstruction/likelihood tests and reported dimensions.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Retain distinct PCA reconstruction and Gaussian FA likelihood interpretations; no intrinsic-dimension claim.

requirements.requirement: Event responses and descriptive population geometry
requirements.existing: Go-cue alignment, training-trial condition summaries, covariance cosine, CCA and principal angles were computed and documented descriptively.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Use descriptive labels, explicit condition keys, units, coverage masks and no neuron-identity/causal inference.

requirements.requirement: Reliable trial-residual population covariance
requirements.existing: Condition/time-specific residual code and plots exist.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: Maze Small compatible conditions have only two or three training repetitions; no reliable residual correlation inference.
requirements.consequence: Trial variability cannot be separated confidently from estimation noise or condition tuning.
dependencies: independently replicated compatible conditions; researcher covariance estimand
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: Conditional; Codex can audit/analyze suitable real data after protocol approval.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Prospective condition/time keys and adequate independent trial repetitions established by feasibility audit; uncertainty and negative results reported without pooling incompatible conditions.

requirements.requirement: Generalizable neural dynamics or manifold stability
requirements.existing: Trial-local AR(1), persistence, mean and time-permuted controls ran; geometry metrics reported.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: Only teacher-forced one-step forecasts in one session and in-sample/noisy anchors; no multi-step or replicated stability test.
requirements.consequence: Cannot infer physiological dynamical mechanism or robust shared manifold.
dependencies: suitable sessions and held-out forecast protocol
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: Conditional; Codex can execute fixed analyses, not choose interpretation.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Prespecified held-out sessions/trials and multi-step or geometry controls quantify performance and uncertainty; report limits of causal/mechanistic inference.

requirements.requirement: Classical neural-to-behavior prediction
requirements.existing: Mean, go-time, linear/ridge, PCA/FA ridge and Kalman run on aligned real Maze units with common observations.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Preserve the shared source-validation protocol and offline same-bin interpretation.

requirements.requirement: Causal prospective or online decoding claim
requirements.existing: Causal architectures constrain neural input to current/past bins; recorded behavior is predicted offline.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: No prospective online replay latency/throughput/feedback experiment or untouched deployment set.
requirements.consequence: Claims of real-time or biological closed-loop decoding are unsupported.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: Conditional; Codex can build a local replay test, not validate an implanted/live system independently.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: If claimed, fix timing budget and protocol; test timestamped online replay, dropped data, causal latency and restoration on representative hardware, then keep biological claims separate.

requirements.requirement: Session indexing and contact correspondence
requirements.existing: LINK native contact keys align across four inspected dates; session IDs/clocks retained and unit identity not inferred.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Continue to label contact mapping as feature correspondence only.

requirements.requirement: Frozen transfer and calibration methods with budget curves
requirements.existing: Source-only selection, target calibration prefixes, direct ridge, residual correction, marginal normalization, condition anchors and curves ran on real LINK.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Retain method-specific information access and negative/unstable small-budget outcomes.

requirements.requirement: Robust cross-session adaptation across independent dates
requirements.existing: Jan30 and Feb05 target experiments were run; later date selected before outcomes.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: One animal and a few inspected dates; Feb05 frozen MSE 0.03340539 exceeds source mean 0.02606807, low-budget calibration is mixed.
requirements.consequence: No general calibration efficiency or drift-robustness claim follows.
dependencies: new untouched session/animal; no reuse for selection
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: Conditional; Codex can run locked protocol, human selects claim/threshold.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Evaluate fixed models and budgets on newly reserved sessions with independent session units and source-only decisions; compare source and label-matched means and report negative results.

requirements.requirement: Masked and predictive SSL, controlled transfer software
requirements.existing: Masked reconstruction and next-bin objective, multi-recording pretraining, frozen probes, fine-tuning and matched random/supervised controls executed.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Keep the result labeled executed SSL/transfer experiments; no validated foundation label.

requirements.requirement: General transferable representation and foundation claim
requirements.existing: Three-session LINK SSL transfer and Feb05 reference evaluation ran; date identity probes retain information.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: One animal/task, near-identical or mixed SSL-versus-random outcomes, no cross-subject/general-task validation; source date identity ~98% decodable.
requirements.consequence: Foundation-model terminology would overstate empirical evidence.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: No; Codex can run locked study but human owns model/claim and data access.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Prespecified independent-session/subject/task tests with matched random and supervised controls, leakage diagnostics and practical effect rule; validated claim only if evidence supports it.

requirements.requirement: Subject-aware transfer with compatible targets
requirements.existing: FALCON anonymous population moments and subject diagnostic run on authentic neural units.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: Targets are author-preprocessed before splits; only two animals, one original date per subject for initial analysis, no stable unit mapping, date/subject confounds.
requirements.consequence: Exploratory comparison cannot establish learned cross-subject representation transfer.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: No; depends on suitable original targets and independent subjects.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Prespecified across-subject held-out experiment with documented coverage, split-safe compatible target processing, no false unit matching and matched controls.

requirements.requirement: MLP, GRU/LSTM, causal CNN/Transformer and state-space implementation
requirements.existing: All six families trained/evaluated on real Maze; prefix/trial causality tests and CPU/MPS software smokes passed.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Maintain causal masks/resets and describe the state-space model as diagonal linear recurrence, not Mamba.

requirements.requirement: Leakage guards and provenance for CEREBRO fitting
requirements.existing: Train-only normalizers and immutable splits, original-row chronology, trial resets, saved hashes and mutation tests are implemented.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Retain guards and state that upstream FALCON processing is a separate unresolved issue.

requirements.requirement: Independent final evaluation after exploratory model inspection
requirements.existing: Chronological target evaluation and source validation splits exist; Mission014 new dates were selected before outcomes.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: Maze source validation and all current LINK/FALCON new-date evaluation sets are now inspected; no fresh untouched final model-selection holdout remains for broader claims.
requirements.consequence: Additional tuning against them would invalidate independent performance inference.
dependencies: new reserved public assets and split identities
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: Conditional; Codex can freeze/run protocol after human design.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Reserve new dataset/session/subject before method choices; train/select without its outcomes; execute once and report all primary contrasts regardless of direction.

requirements.requirement: Uncertainty and multiple-comparison interpretation
requirements.existing: Trial-weighted MSE, paired trial and moving-block sensitivity intervals, seed ranges and negative contrasts are available.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: Block length/dependence assumptions and multiple comparisons are not calibrated for population claims; seeds are not biological replicates.
requirements.consequence: Intervals cannot be sold as significance or generalization evidence.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: Conditional; Codex can implement tests after researcher chooses inference target.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Researcher-approved independent unit, dependence/multiplicity plan and practical effect criterion fixed before new evaluation; uncertainty reported for all named contrasts.

requirements.requirement: Package, documented workflows, clean install and CI
requirements.existing: Python3.11 package, pinned direct dependencies, fresh Conda run of 46 commands, 222 full local tests and 210 software CI tests passed.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Document the distinction: public CI collects but does not execute 12 real-data cases.

requirements.requirement: Artifact registry and checkpoint restoration portability
requirements.existing: 350 registry digests/529 array digests checked; 229 CPU predictions replayed, 227 exact.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: Unsupported checkpoint formats get integrity/workflow restoration only; representation07 random probes need seeded encoder/architecture/Torch recreation.
requirements.consequence: Some exported models are not independently portable inference artifacts.
dependencies: only if standalone model exchange is in release scope
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: For any advertised standalone model, ship self-contained architecture/scaler/weights metadata and verify fresh-process raw-count-to-output restoration; preserve historical archives.

requirements.requirement: Local interactive research explorer
requirements.existing: Self-contained HTML with real trial, decoder, PCA, calibration and ablation controls; verified in browser.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Keep offline data labeling and provenance visible; no device-control claim.

requirements.requirement: Cross-platform and security assurance beyond tested scope
requirements.existing: Fresh macOS/CPU+MPS and Linux software CI pass; tracked credential/data heuristic scan clean.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: No full-data Linux/Windows reproduction, CUDA test, standalone typecheck or exhaustive secret/history/dependency audit.
requirements.consequence: Portability and security claims must stay bounded to performed checks.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: Conditional; Codex can run on available hosts only.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: For each platform claimed in release, run clean install plus documented applicable workflows and checks; perform defined security review before claiming certification.

requirements.requirement: Real intracortical data, timing, causality, decoding and calibration
requirements.existing: The repository demonstrates offline engineering competencies through authentic NWB recordings, masks, causal model tests, decoding and adaptation experiments.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Describe only demonstrated offline research skills, with no clinical, implant or employment claim.
requirements.scope: competency mapping, not original release gate

requirements.requirement: Streaming, latency, failure handling and actual closed-loop validation
requirements.existing: No live acquisition adapter, timing budget, closed-loop controller, device integration or biological feedback study.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: A safe online interface and representative hardware/clinical access are outside current repository capabilities.
dependencies: human product scope and hardware access
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: No; Codex could build simulated replay only after requirements, not validate implanted operation.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: If explicitly added to scope, require a human-approved safety/use specification, timestamped streaming/latency/failure tests and separately authorized real-system study.
requirements.scope: adjacent competency, not original release gate

requirements.domain: Final research artifacts and public release
requirements.requirement: Scientific reports, figures, attribution and limitations
requirements.existing: Versioned reports/figures, source citations, CC-BY-4.0 attribution, negative findings and explicit limitations exist.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: yes
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Preserve provenance, historical results and corrected terminology.

requirements.domain: Final research artifacts and public release
requirements.requirement: Full-scope release decision, PR merge and final tag
requirements.existing: Draft PR1 is public at dd335c2; software audit and CI pass; v0.1.0 preserved.
requirements.missing_evidence_or_capability: Scientific gates D3/D4/F2/E2 are unresolved, and explicit human review/publication approval has not occurred.
requirements.consequence: A final full-scope release claim or tag would overstate validation.
requirements.codex_can_resolve_independently: No; researcher owns publication approval and conclusions.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Original completion criteria are checked against independently valid evidence; researcher approves exact head/version; merge normally and tag only then.
